page.overview:
What is Circus Animatronics?

The Circus animatronics are a set of circus-themed animatronic counterparts, and exclusively appeared as marketable Five Nights at Freddy's products since their debut in Winter 2023 by Funko Inc.

Circus Freddy is Freddy Fazbear's counterpart with blue accessories with a red flower attached to his hat and a large red bow with white polka dots and is wearing gloves. He has white makeup on with a red nose. He is available as a plush toy, figure, and Funko POP!

Circus Bonnie is Bonnie the Rabbit's counterpart with white gloves, a neck ruff, and cotton balls and has white makeup on his face and ears, with a red nose. The ends of his ears hold bells. He is available as a plush toy and a figure.

Circus Chica is Chica the Chicken's counterpart, with similarities to Glamrock Chica. She is fully white, with two ponytails, one of which is fully pink and the other is half pink. She is wearing a pink and green party hat and a pink shirt with a darker pink vest and a white tie with blue lines on it. She has a green skirt on with pink patches and pink leggings with blue polka dots. She is available as a figure.
